snippet.title: Broomstick Exorcist Combat Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Download and wishlist now on Steam! 🧹https://store.steampowered.com/app/3875730/Broomstick_Exorcist_Combat_Demo/

Play as Vikka, a street sweeper who hunts demons at night while keeping the street clean. Devour the darkness in a night filled with demons in this unique 2D, hand-drawn, Manga-inspired beat 'em-up horror adventure.
